description: State Agency Water and Sewer Usage in Colorado is a dataset listed in State of Colorado open data portal (data.colorado.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a region, state, county or agency, published or maintained by State of Colorado. Water, sewage, and steam useage for facilities utilized by state agencies dating back to fiscal year 2015 provided by the Colorado Energy Office (CEO). Coverage: Colorado. The portal files it under the category Energy. Its tags are bic, irrigation, energy, colorado energy office, colorado. The table has 6 columns. Attribution on the portal: CEO. The portal shows 2018-05-09 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support wastewater and sewer network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-colorado-gov-portal.
